caption:
A tractor took his leg at 17. Nine years later, he'd broken his own javelin world record for the second time.

Sumit Antil spent 53 days bed-bound after the accident before he was even fitted with a prosthetic. Two years later, he picked up a javelin. He's now won back-to-back Paralympic gold and holds the F64 world record at 74.82 metres. The leg he lost set the terms. It never set the ceiling.
